items.heading: CA Remains One
items.text: CA remains one of the strongest default professional credentials in India for anyone who wants deep, India-specific expertise in accounting, taxation, and audit. Family-run businesses, PSUs, and mid-sized Indian companies still reach for a CA before a CFA or a generic MBA when they need someone to own compliance and financial reporting end to end.

items.heading: Before the Pass
items.text: Before the pass-rate numbers make sense, it helps to know what each level is actually testing. This is not a light syllabus skimmed alongside a degree, it is dense, cumulative, and each level builds on the last.

items.heading: Coaching Institute Ads Show Toppers
items.text: Coaching institute ads show toppers and record placement packages. They rarely lead with the pass-percentage table, because the table is the least flattering part of the pitch.

rows: The first filter. Most people who "start CA" never clear this level at all.
This is the level that quietly ends most people's attempt. Single-group pass rates run higher (16-25%), but clearing both groups together is brutally rare.
Even after surviving Foundation, Intermediate, and 2-3 years of articleship, the final hurdle still fails the majority of attempts.
